content: Explain what python is in simple words

Python is a popular computer programming language. Think of it like a friendly way to give instructions to a computer to tell it what to do! It is famous for being easy to read and write—almost like writing in plain English. People use Python for many exciting things, such as building websites, creating games, analyzing data, and even teaching artificial intelligence.
That is fantastic to hear! Python is such a fun, versatile, and powerful language to learn. It is a great choice for a favorite subject!
